model: ideal rigid circular piston, infinite baffle, far field on axis: |p| proportional to piston area A = pi*d^2/4
label: ANALYTIC_FIXTURE (no BEM, no calibration)
note: At one frequency, volume velocity is Sd times surface velocity OR Sd times displacement; both scale with area, so the two ideal-piston limits coincide at +4.59 dB. The +2.30 dB figure is the diameter ratio, not a pressure-scaling limit, and must not be quoted as one.
caveat: The simulated rise (+3.6 dB median) is below the ideal-piston area limit (+4.59 dB); the difference is not a calibration and must not be interpreted as efficiency, sensitivity or a driver model.
